description: This file defines a helper class for generating JWT authentication tokens for testing purposes. It provides methods to get tokens for admin and normal users by creating JWTs with specific claims and roles.

classes.name: ApiTokenHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to generate JWT tokens for different user roles for integration testing.

methods.name: GetAdminUserToken
methods.description: Generates and returns a JWT token for an administrator user.

methods.name: GetNormalUserToken
methods.description: Generates and returns a JWT token for a normal user.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with specified username and roles, including setting claims, expiration, and signing credentials.
